description: Check whether an IP would be blocked by the firewall. Pass path (and method) to evaluate route-scoped block rules the way the running app does, including case and trailing-slash aliases.

appKey.description: Optional application key UUID to test the app/environment toggle and scoped lists.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

method.description: Optional HTTP method for the path, default GET.

path.description: Optional request path, for example /api/auth/login. Without it, route-scoped rules are not evaluated.

name: securenow_firewall_test_ip
title: Test Firewall IP Decision
